title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox pitcher Payton Tolle recorded 14 strikeouts in a 13-1 win over the Athletics, striking out nine of the first 12 batters.
The Boston Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, improving their season record to 64-51.
Boston's offense accumulated 15 hits, including contributions from Jarren Duran and Jake Rogers, to secure the decisive victory.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are engaged in intensive matchups at Patriots training camp, enhancing each other's performance.
Christian Gonzalez uses strategic trash talk against A.J. Brown to simulate competition with leading NFL receivers.
New England Patriots indicate a potential contract deal with Gonzalez amidst his dynamic camp performance against Pro Bowl receiver Brown.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman will start a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester Red Sox on Saturday due to left wrist inflammation.
Rutschman was acquired by the Boston Red Sox from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez.
Rutschman, a three-time All-Star, could soon join Boston's main roster, which is currently in a strong playoff position.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: "Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender" continues Aang's adventures on Paramount+ with Dave Bautista joining the cast.
"You, Me & Tuscany" features Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page in a romantic comedy set in the Italian countryside, streaming on Peacock.
"Ted Lasso" Season 4 returns with Jason Sudeikis leading a women's team in the fictional AFC Richmond, available on Apple TV.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet, previously a starter for the Red Sox, may return to the bullpen after injury setbacks.
Crochet hasn't pitched since April due to left shoulder inflammation and subsequent lat strain recovery issues.
Interim manager Chad Tracy indicated Crochet is unlikely to start, but might join Boston's bullpen if healthy.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester on Wednesday.
The snake was left in a cage in a community garden and taken to Roslindale's animal care facility.
Boston Animal Care and Control asks for information on the snake's owner at 617-635-1800.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 win against Drake Maye's Team White in Patriots' scrimmage.
DeVito completed 13-of-16 passes with two touchdowns, while Maye finished 10-of-19 despite early struggles.
Wide receiver DeMario Douglas made six catches for two touchdowns, including a 50-yard play for Team Blue.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The town features nearly 11 miles of tidal shoreline along Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay.
Harwich offers diverse attractions, including beaches, cultural sites, conservation areas, and local eateries with oyster specials.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Plymouth County DA's office clarified that someone said 'shut it off' about autopsy photos, not 'shut her up'.
Defense attorney accused prosecutors of making inappropriate comments during testimony in Lindsay Clancy trial.
Judge Sullivan warned against inappropriate comments in court, stating offenders would be removed without warning.

title: Little boy dancing to DJ on Boston Common has hundreds of thousands of new fans
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: 4-year-old Chukwuemeka Ikesinachi-Nwogwugwu gained 200,000 likes after a dance video with DJ on Boston Common went viral.
Chukwuemeka's mother, Chidimma Ikesinachi, was surprised by viral attention and praised the positive impact of the video.
DJ Miss S. Peace held the popup show to promote connection; Kelly Werme encouraged Chukwuemeka to join the dancing.
